steps.label: starting-one-element-stops-the-others
steps.script: (async()=>{const a=document.getElementById('pb-audio');const v=document.createElement('video');v.muted=true;document.body.appendChild(v);a.src='data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=';v.src=a.src;try{await a.play()}catch(e){}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));const audioWasPlaying=!a.paused;try{await v.play()}catch(e){}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));const res={audioWasPlaying, audioStoppedWhenVideoStarted:a.paused};v.pause();v.remove();return res.audioStoppedWhenVideoStarted})()
